thread:
sven: Heads-up — private VPC RC2 packaging is built and uploaded to staging mirror. Need final signoff for release notes and pin before we open canary (target window 16:00 PT). TL;DR: boot-image v1.9.0, installer v2.4.1, shrinkwrap + delta metadata.

deploybot: Packaging artifact created: artifacts/private-vpc/rc2/2026-03-21.tar.gz
sha256: f3b2a9c1e4a9d2f2c9d9c2b7a1f8d2c6c4a5b6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d
cosign: signed by key-id rwinf-release-2026 (exp 2026-04-07)
Checks: unit/pack: pass, checksum-verify: pass, shrinkwrap-compare: warnings(1)

maya: quick question — the cosign key expiry is 2 weeks out. Do we rotate now or include a blurb in release notes that key rotates post-cutover?

anita: we should rotate after cutover to avoid breaking mirrors in-flight. add a note in release docs and create follow-up ticket for key rotation + KMS policy. :thumbsup:

lee: Can we confirm rollback criteria? If the canary shows image pull failures or checksum mismatch we want immediate manifest revert. Suggested rollback steps in order: 1) set manifest pin to v1.8.2, 2) trigger mirror re-sync, 3) abort any in-flight canary promotes, 4) open incident channel.

tom: +1. Also add a fast rollback command snippet for oncall: ```./releasectl pin --env private-vpc --manifest tag:v1.8.2 && ./deploybot abort-canary --channel private-vpc``` Keep it a single command alias: `fastpin`

ops-bot: Canary started at 16:00 PT against 3 seed nodes (eu-west, us-west, ap-south). Baseline latency and pod health capture in /metrics/releases/rc2-canary. Will post back at +15m, +1h.

maya: Release notes draft (short):
- Private/VPC RC2: Installer v2.4.1, includes boot-image v1.9.0 (faster coldstart), shrinkwrap deltas to reduce airgap bundle size by ~7%.
- Security: cosign-signed artifacts; key rotation planned post-cutover.
- Fixes: improved mirror retry logic for slow carriers; added extra checksum verification for partial downloads.

anita: Add known issue: customers with very old mirror proxies (curl <7.58) may see TLS resume errors; workaround: disable connection reuse or upgrade proxy. Ticket #RELEASE-489

sven: All good from my side. Pinning signer key until 05:00 PT tomorrow and blocking any auto-unpin flows. @deploybot please hold auto-promote. :lock:

deploybot: Auto-promote disabled for this manifest. Canary continues. Will report back 16:15PT.

ops-bot: 16:15 update: canary healthy on latency and pod churn. One node had transient image pull stall (kubelet retry), resolved after manual cache flush. Noted in incident log but not blocking.

tom: Given the transient pull stall, let's still proceed to a small staged promote (20% customer seeds) but keep `fastpin` ready and ops on standby. I'll draft the promote command: `./deploybot promote --manifest rc2 --pct 20 --env private-vpc --monitor 30m`

sven: Agreed. Promote at 16:30 PT, ops standby, release notes final as updated. Everyone on this thread as approvers? If no objections by 16:25 PT I'll run the promote.

maya: Approved.

anita: Approved.

lee: Approved (ops standby).

deploybot: Promote queued for 16:30 PT. Logging the action id: DB-20260321-3177.

sven: Thanks team — will follow up with the post-cutover note and the key-rotation ticket after the promote completes.
